pages.text: You have uncovered the truth of the great extinction that once befell the Primordial Caves. With the power of this spell, you call upon the spirit of a Tremorsaurus to fight alongside you. During the blessing, each of your melee attacks triggers a coordinated strike from the Tremorsaurus spirit.

A Nether Staff slightly increases the damage of the Tremorsaurus spirit. This spell accepts the Potency and Duration enchantments; Potency increases its damage, while Duration extends the blessing's duration.
